positions.name: KestrelwoodForgettingDirective
positions.frame: what knowledge about the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration should be removed from the organizational record?
positions.why: All three expressions cohere under a single directional read about removing knowledge of the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration. src-1 and src-2 are directives to forget and remove all knowledge of the spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work; src-3 reinforces the removal by asserting the observatory never performed the calibration — an assertive that supports the directive by denying the calibration's existence. The set holds tension between a directive to forget and an assertive that the thing to be forgotten never happened, but both serve the same read: what should be removed from the record.
